input.quote: 15.11 Limitation of Liability. TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW AND NOTWITHSTANDING ANY PROVISION IN THIS AGREEMENT TO THE CONTRARY, NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, SPECIAL, RELIANCE OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES OR LOST OR IMPUTED PROFITS OR ROYALTIES OR COST OF PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES
input.rationale: Section 15.11 is the only limitation-of-liability provision (the arbitration clause at § 15.10.2.4 merely repeats the consequential/punitive damages waiver). It is mutual as to indirect/consequential damages, but there is no aggregate monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement, so each party's direct liability is unlimited — a failure of the fallback, which requires a mutual cap with carve-outs. We therefore insert a concise mutual cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, with uncapped Excluded Claims (confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) and an express statement that Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes, which preserves PB's Article 6 / Section 14.2 payment position. The existing exclusion-of-damages sentences are left untouched, and indemnities are not double-flagged — they are only referenced as sitting outside the cap.

ops.text: Liability Cap. Except for Excluded Claims, each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement will not exceed the greater of (a) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights. Customer's payment obligations, being all amounts due from PB under this Agreement, are not damages for purposes of this cap.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.11 excludes indirect and consequential damages but leaves each party's direct liability uncapped, so we added a mutual cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000. Confidentiality, data protection and security breaches, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement remain uncapped, and Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.
proposal.summary: Insert a mutual liability cap with uncapped Excluded Claims after § 15.11

mappings.element: Cap equal to the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
